question: Which of the following ministries had the highest percentage increase in budgetary allocation for Budget 2020-21?

options.text: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers’ Welfare
Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Communications**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Union Budget of India for 2020–2021 was presented by the Finance Minister, Nirmala Sitharaman on 1 February 2020.
 
• It was structured on the overall theme of **“Ease of Living”**.
 
• Among the top 13 ministries with the highest allocations, the highest percentage increase was observed in the **Ministry of Communications (129%)**__, followed by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare (30%) and the Ministry of Home Affairs (20%).
 
• The Union Budget 2020 aimed-
 
 
• To achieve seamless delivery of services through Digital governance
 
• To improve the physical quality of life through National Infrastructure Pipeline
 
• Risk mitigation through Disaster Resilience
 
• Social security through Pension and Insurance penetration
 
 
 
• The three components of Aspirational India were-
 
 
• Agriculture, Irrigation and Rural Development
 
• Wellness, Water and Sanitation
 
• Education and Skills
